nodes.title: measured@1 (C1 item 5, geometry by constraint): a shape the kit states with its measures (geometry.js: 'rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm', 'length .. breadth ..', 'square of side 7 m', 'triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 cm', 'circle of radius 5 cm'; the first stated; units must agree) is drawn TO SCALE: rectangle / square with its dimensions on its sides, a triangle built from its three sides (law of cosines; triangle inequality checked), a circle with a radius arrow and 'r = 5 cm' below it. md.decisions:
## dc-r7-board-geometry-to-scale: shapes drawn to their real measures (2026-11-04)

When a maths lesson talks about a rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm, a triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 cm or a circle of radius 5 cm, the board now draws exactly that shape in the right proportions, with each measure written beside it.
md.measurements:
## ms-r7-board-geometry-reach (2026-11-04, n = 22 kits)

22 maths lessons state a measured shape; all pass the board gates. In 11 the to-scale shape is now the board shown.
